exposure: 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine with buprenorphine for spinal anaesthesia
0.5% hyperbaric levobupivacaine with buprenorphine for spinal anaesthesia
cohort: Seventy parturients scheduled for elective caesarean section were included in the study.
finding: 0.5% hyperbaric levobupivacaine produced a shorter duration of sensory and motor blockade compared to 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine, with no significant differences in onset of block or intraoperative hemodynamics.
